facts_raw.Program Type: Founder Network + VC Fund Ecosystem (not current accelerator)
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: All Access founder network + Texas Fund direct investment pathway; current site explicitly says All Access is not an accelerator.
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Current Model Is Network + Fund, Not Accelerator
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Current All Access targets experienced founders ready to scale; Texas Fund targets ambitious deep/frontier-tech founders, particularly Texas ecosystem.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site Required: Network-based / Texas ecosystem; not a fixed residency
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 Texas, US 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Status: Current All Access / Texas Fund doors active
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
facts_raw.Notes: Critical correction: old accelerator page describes a historical 1% stock model. Do NOT surface that as a current 2026 accelerator term.
